prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a side impact at intersection. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1192; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours are a little high for this damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The vehicle sustained damage along the driver-side door panel, rear quarter panel and the adjacent rocker area, with crease marks and paint transfer that line up with the reported side impact at the intersection. Nothing in the inspection suggests older collision damage, and no prior repairs were found on the affected panels. The proposed plan calls for door replacement, quarter panel repair and refinishing, and a pillar realignment check. Labor hours appear slightly high for this scope and should be reviewed with the shop before approval. Parts and invoices submitted so far show no duplicate charges.
